Market today: The market mood is cautious. Fed official Warsh's comments, while not signaling rate changes, praised global tightening, hinting at continued hawkish pressure. This creates uncertainty for growth-oriented tech and chip names, especially with your margin exposure.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.24%), MUU (-26.06%), and SPAL (-35.19%) are deep in the red and leveraged, amplifying losses. SMCI (-20.03%) also shows significant drawdown. Margin amplifies these drops, making risk management critical.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further Fed commentary for clearer rate signals. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs, as their decay and deep losses demand immediate attention.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Immediately review and adjust stops for SOXL, MUU, SPAL, and SMCI. Their current prices are significantly below listed stops, indicating past breaches or unmanaged risk.
Consider trimming QQQ (SELL, 1.87% gain) and SMH (TRIM, -12.18% loss) to reduce overall portfolio risk, given their scanner statuses.
No new buys today - hold and watch. There are no compelling catalysts from headlines to support new scanner setups.
